Package placement

Class Application

java.lang.Object
placement.Application
public class Application extends Object
Represents a single application submitted by a Student for an Internship. This class tracks the application's status, from submission through approval, acceptance, or withdrawal.

  • Constructor Details

    • Application

      public Application(int aid, Student s, Internship i)
      Constructs a new Application instance. This is used when a student creates a new application.
      Parameters:
      aid - The unique ID for the application, generated by ApplicationStore.
      s - The Student who is applying.
      i - The Internship being applied for.

    • Application

      public Application(int aid, Student s, Internship i, ApplicationStatus status, LocalDateTime submittedAt, boolean acceptedByStudent, boolean studentWithdrawalRequested, boolean careerStaffWithdrawalAccepted)
      Constructs an Application instance from existing data. This is used by ApplicationBuilder when loading data from a file.
      Parameters:
      aid - The application's unique ID.
      s - The applying Student.
      i - The target Internship.
      status - The current ApplicationStatus.
      submittedAt - The original submission timestamp.
      acceptedByStudent - Whether the student has accepted the offer.
      studentWithdrawalRequested - Whether the student has requested to withdraw.
      careerStaffWithdrawalAccepted - Whether staff has approved the withdrawal.

    • approveWithdrawal

      public void approveWithdrawal()
      Approves a student's withdrawal request. Called by CareerStaff. If the student had already accepted this offer, it also frees up a slot in the internship.

      public void rejectWithdrawal()
      Rejects a student's withdrawal request. Called by CareerStaff.
